Package GUI

Class ServiceRepDashboardController

java.lang.Object
GUI.ServiceRepDashboardController
public class ServiceRepDashboardController extends Object
Controller for the Service Representative Dashboard. This class manages the main dashboard displayed to service representatives. It provides access to subscriber and guide management, profile editing, logout, and application exit.
